description: Authorized AP, DHCP, and NAT controller for CardputerZero

store.summary: Authorized wired-WAN Wi-Fi AP, DHCP, and NAT controller
store.description: A native, fail-closed CardputerZero interface for creating an authorized WPA2 access point with a physical wired Ethernet WAN, private DHCP/DNS state, and package-owned nftables NAT. TLS interception and packet capture are excluded from this release.
